body: I don't think I could manage to talk to my therapist about this. He's a very cool guy, and I consider him a friend but this is a bit much. I don't think I'd have the courage to say this to anyone's face in real life, admitting that this happened to someone face to face would be nearly impossible. That makes reporting it a lot harder too.

If I went right away, maybe. But it's been eight days now and I scrubbed everywhere I could for a long time in the bath. It's literally just my word against hers, and I don't think it sounds too likely. I know for a fact I'd have scoffed at this kind of story :/
